name.en: Delhi Domestic Electricity Subsidy Scheme (Up to 200 Units Free; 201–400 50% Slab)

bilingual_title.en: Delhi Domestic Electricity Subsidy Scheme (Up to 200 Units Free; 201–400 50% Slab)

eligibility_criteria.domicile_ncr_rule: Domestic metered connection inside NCT of Delhi; Gurugram/Noida excluded.
eligibility_criteria.exclusions: Commercial connections & consumption above notified subsidy ceiling.

benefit.summary_hi: दिल्ली घरेलू बिजली उपभोक्ताओं (विकल्प चुनने पर) को 200 यूनिट तक 100% व 201–400 यूनिट पर 50% सब्सिडी ([नोटिस सत्यापित करें])।
benefit.summary_en: Domestic electricity tariff subsidy (historically up to 200 units/mo free; 201–400 units 50% slab, subject to opt-in & tariff rules [VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION]).

benefit_summary.en: Domestic electricity tariff subsidy (historically up to 200 units/mo free; 201–400 units 50% slab, subject to opt-in & tariff rules [VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION]).
benefit_summary.hi: दिल्ली घरेलू बिजली उपभोक्ताओं (विकल्प चुनने पर) को 200 यूनिट तक 100% व 201–400 यूनिट पर 50% सब्सिडी ([नोटिस सत्यापित करें])।

application_steps.online: Opt-in via Discom portal (TPDDL/BRPL/BYPL) or power.delhi.gov.in.

verification_note.hi: नोट ([VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION]): वर्तमान 2026–27 सक्रिय आवेदन विंडो, स्लैब व अंतिम नियम कृपया आधिकारिक सरकारी पोर्टल पर सत्यापित करें।
verification_note.en: Notice ([VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION]): Always verify active 2026–27 window, exact slab/amount, and current circular on the official portal before applying.

anti_dalal.csc_fee_note_hi: सरकारी CFC या CSC केंद्र पर केवल निर्धारित सेवा शुल्क (₹0–₹50) व पक्की रसीद लागू
anti_dalal.csc_fee_note_en: Nominal authorized CFC/CSC facilitation fee only (always take printed receipt)
anti_dalal.receipt_rule: Always collect your official Acknowledgement Slip & Reference Number after submission. Never pay without a printed receipt.
anti_dalal.middleman_warning: Never pay agents/middlemen promising guaranteed approval or faster clearance. Benefits are disbursed strictly via DBT / official portals.
